leaves.label: Social Realism
leaves.defn: A drama of ordinary working or poor people shown in their material conditions — labour, unemployment, the street, the village (Salt of the Earth, Rosetta, I, Daniel Blake, Salaam Bombay!). A drama built around one named social issue goes to A16-22; Italian neorealism and kitchen-sink realism as movements to A1.
leaves.axis: by where the hardship falls: work and labour, unemployment and precarity, street life and slums, then the village

leaves.label: Relationship Drama

leaves.axis: by the span of the relationship shown: one encounter, years, distance, crisis, late life
